'''Kolstad''': {{legend0|#ffb2b2|40–50%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Max Baucus]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Max Baucus]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Montana}} The '''1990 United States Senate election in Montana''' took place on November 6, 1990. Incumbent United States Senator [[Max Baucus]], who was first elected in [[1978 United States Senate election in Montana|1978]] and was re-elected in [[1984 United States Senate election in Montana|1984]], ran for re-election. After winning the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] primary, he moved on to the general election, where he was opposed by [[Allen Kolstad]], the [[Lieutenant Governor of Montana]] and the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] nominee. Baucus ultimately ended up defeating Kolstad in a [[Landslide victory|landslide]], winning his third term with ease. ==Democratic primary == ===Candidates === * [[Max Baucus]], incumbent [[United
